query:
SELECT 
  m.id,
  m.slot,
  m.day,
  m.time,
  m.sponsorId,
  m.attendeeId,
  m.attendeeNumber,
  m.score,
  s.name as sponsorName,
  a.name as delegateName,
  a.company as delegateCompany
FROM meetings m
LEFT JOIN sponsors s ON m.sponsorId = s.id
LEFT JOIN attendees a ON m.attendeeId = a.id
ORDER BY m.attendeeId, m.slot;
